entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I hear you are constructing a pipe..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hear you are constructing a pipeline between Rizia and Morella. Can it be extended to my country?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I doubt that Morella would allow s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I doubt that Morella would allow such an extension given your history."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're right. We shouldn't be gett..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right. We shouldn't be getting too far ahead of ourselves."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""It is not Derdia's fault that we a..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is not Derdia's fault that we are cruelly barred from our ancestral places of worship."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Perfect. Derdia, Rizia and Morella..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perfect. Derdia, Rizia and Morella will stand strong against the CSP's overreach."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Perfect. Derdia, Rizia and Morella will stand strong together against Arcasian imperialism."

entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""But for a chance at energy securit..."
entries.dialogueText: "But for a chance at energy security, I am willing to face the devil herself."

entries.dialogueText: "Once energy is flowing from Rizia to Derdia, we can begin to talk about further cooperation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We would be, if we had any energy..."
entries.dialogueText: "We would be, if we had any energy to sell you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am afraid not. We barely have en..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am afraid not. We barely have enough energy to meet Morella's needs, let alone Derdia's."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I agree to extend the pipeline. Bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree to extend the pipeline. But you must be ready to stop your disgraceful border violations."
entries.menuText: "I agree to extend the pipeline. But you must be ready to stop your disgraceful border violations." [-2 Energy For +4 Budget Per Turn, -2 Budget Per Turn For Pipeline]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Excellent. We will begin the pipel..."
entries.dialogueText: "Excellent. We will begin the pipeline, and our three nations will begin a new era of peace and cooperation."
entries.menuText: "Excellent. We will begin the pipeline, and our three nations will begin a new era of peace and cooperation." [-2 Energy For +4 Budget Per Turn, -2 Budget Per Turn For Pipeline]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My answer is no. You will have to..."
entries.dialogueText: "My answer is no. You will have to come up with another energy solution."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Peace? Her country discarded that..."
entries.dialogueText: "Peace? Her country discarded that chance when it closed its borders to us."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sal smiled faintly."
entries.dialogueText: Sal smiled faintly.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Ignoring your religious ideals for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ignoring your religious ideals for the sake of earthly riches. Your true colors are showing, Supreme Wiseman."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wouldn't call energy 'riches'. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wouldn't call energy 'riches'. It is a basic need."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Remember Wruhec's words, Sal. Do n..."
entries.dialogueText: "Remember Wruhec's words, Sal. Do not reach for the stars above your head before tending to the soil beneath your feet."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Precisely.""
entries.dialogueText: "Precisely."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Precisely. We cannot honor God if..."
entries.dialogueText: "Precisely. We cannot honor God if we cannot keep the lights on at our sanctuaries."

Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""That's too bad, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's too bad, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Thank you, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All right. An energy agreement it..."
entries.dialogueText: "All right. An energy agreement it is."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Nevertheless, I would rather not m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nevertheless, I would rather not make an energy deal at this time."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""It is your energy, Your Majesty. A..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is your energy, Your Majesty. And your decision."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "To be frank, we need your diplomatic support more than we need you to buy our energy."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal

entries.dialogueText: "The Gulf is far north of your front, is it not? Shipping has not been disrupted so far."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Our great Nurist republic will end..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our great Nurist republic will endeavor to support you diplomatically as well."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""You're very optimistic. But I woul..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're very optimistic. But I would not count on Morella to offer either of those to us."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""That's unfortunate, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's unfortunate, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He is only trying to provide for h..."
entries.dialogueText: "He is only trying to provide for his people, Grand Wiseman. Just as I am doing in Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Indeed, Azmal. You cannot have it..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed, Azmal. You cannot have it both ways."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""You asked me about closer ties, Yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "You asked me about closer ties, Your Majesty. This is my answer."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Diplomatic support from a country..."
entries.dialogueText: "Diplomatic support from a country with rolling blackouts. I'm not sure how much that's worth, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""When two like souls converge, the..."
entries.dialogueText: "When two like souls converge, the Divine smiles upon them."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Both superpowers are equally repug..."
entries.dialogueText: "Both superpowers are equally repugnant to me, Your Majesty. All I wish is for both of them to leave Derdia alone."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Still, I see much potential.""
entries.dialogueText: "Still, I see much potential."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""'United' is not the word for it. B..."
entries.dialogueText: "'United' is not the word for it. But if Rizia wishes for us to keep the peace, we shall."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Wehlen? Your Majesty, Wiktor Smola..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wehlen? Your Majesty, Wiktor Smolak's persecution of Golcondists makes Morella's border controls seem gentle."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's exactly the kind of strengt..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's exactly the kind of strengthened ties I was thinking of, Supreme Wiseman."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Ah. So I heard wrong.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ah. So I heard wrong."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Empire of Moridia, united once..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Empire of Moridia, united once more. It warms my heart."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Derdia_NegotiatingPower -= 1

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Yes, we cannot be expected to carr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, we cannot be expected to carry out our religious duties without heat or electricity."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""We ourselves have implemented roll..."
entries.dialogueText: "We ourselves have implemented rolling blackouts recently."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""He will not even grant our pilgrim..."
entries.dialogueText: "He will not even grant our pilgrims passage through his country to the holy Archsanctuary of Deyr. And you think he will trade with us?"

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Think about it. Once your Zille ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Think about it. Once your Zille harbor is recovered, the distance between our ports will be practically nothing."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""It will be easier to trade with Ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "It will be easier to trade with Rizia once your Zille harbor is recovered from that madman."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Azmal's eyes lit up."
entries.dialogueText: Azmal's eyes lit up.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I would welcome the chance for Der..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would welcome the chance for Derdia to grow closer to our Rizian brothers."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""But as long as you continue to sup..."
entries.dialogueText: "But as long as you continue to support Golcondists, we will endeavor to support you in whatever matters we can."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""But we will endeavor to support yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "But we will endeavor to support you however we can."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""We may not be able to help each ot..."
entries.dialogueText: "We may not be able to help each other with our energy needs. But you will have our support in other matters."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Regardless, we will do our best to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Regardless, we will do our best to support you in other matters if that is what you desire."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""As long as you do not succumb to t..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as you do not succumb to the Morellans' influence, we will endeavor to support you in whatever matters we can."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""May St. Wruhec bless our bond.""
entries.dialogueText: "May St. Wruhec bless our bond."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will hold you to those words, Su..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will hold you to those words, Supreme Wiseman."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You need not be outspoken in your..."
entries.dialogueText: "You need not be outspoken in your support. Behind the scenes is fine."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""An energy partnership is enough fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "An energy partnership is enough for now, I think."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Azmal looked somewhat wounded."
entries.dialogueText: Azmal looked somewhat wounded.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""If you do not wish to be associate..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you do not wish to be associated with Derdia, we will stay in the shadows."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Azmal nodded slowly."
entries.dialogueText: Azmal nodded slowly.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""We will see where it takes us.""
entries.dialogueText: "We will see where it takes us."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""From now through eternity.""
entries.dialogueText: "From now through eternity."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""From my lips to God's ears.""
entries.dialogueText: "From my lips to God's ears."
